messages.subject: GIRF for a TVAR with external threshold
messages.subject_clean: GIRF for a TVAR with external threshold
messages.body_plain:
Hello

I encountered two issues while estimating a TVAR model that includes an external threshold variable. The first problem is that the TVAR.LRtest function is only working for "1vs" but not for "2vs3". The second issue is that the GIRF function is not working and gives an error message "Error: Simulations of models with external transition variables (argument thVar in TVAR) not supported"

Thanks,
Yas

Hi

The second message is simply telling you that this is not supported.

For the first error, can you please produce a minimal self-reproducible example <https://stackoverflow.com/help/minimal-reproducible-example>, and post it on the Github issue page <https://github.com/MatthieuStigler/tsDyn/issues>?

Thanks
